title: Interpreting Peano arithmetic in Heyting arithmetic

based_on.title: The Proof Theory of Classical and Constructive Inductive Definitions: A 40 year saga (Pohlersfest lecture, July 18, 2008)

summary: Interpret classical arithmetic certificates in HA, check every arithmetic axiom, and recover native conclusions without disjunction or existential quantification.
abstract: Classical and intuitionistic arithmetic use the same numerical operations and induction axioms, but their logical rules give different kinds of conclusions. Negative translation converts every classical arithmetic certificate into a constructive certificate of a translated formula. We check the seven basic axioms and full induction with fixed parameters, connect the interpretation to the established Peano arithmetic calculus, and derive equiconsistency by transforming contradiction certificates. Arithmetic equality then lets us remove the translation from native formulas containing neither disjunction nor existential quantification.
